name: AI Meeting Notes Agent
description: Ingests meeting transcripts or recordings, generates concise summaries and action items, then distributes the results by email in the requested language.

bucket.description: S3 bucket that stores the source object (text, audio, or video).

key.description: Object key of the source asset within the configured bucket.

participants.description: Email recipients that should receive the generated summary.

content_type.description: Type of source content. Audio and video inputs trigger automatic transcription.

media_format.description: Optional hint for the media container or codec (for example mp3, mp4, wav).

target_language.description: ISO language code to translate the final summary into.

language.description: Optional language hint for pre-transcribed text to skip automatic detection.

text.description: Inline transcript text when content_type is 'text' and no S3 object is provided.

summary.description: Meeting summary and action items generated by the agent.

message.description: Delivery status description for the current run.

failed.description: Email addresses that could not be notified when SES delivery fails.

content_type.description: Content type processed for this invocation.

detected_language.description: Language detected from the original transcript.

final_language.description: Language of the final summary after optional translation.

translation_applied.description: Flag indicating whether translation was performed.

target_language.description: Normalized target language requested for translation.
